bill.title: A resolution recognizing the upcoming 250th anniversary of the United States of America and reaffirming the commitment of the Senate to the Nation's founding ideals of liberty, equality, and opportunity for all immigrant communities in the United States.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (text: CR S3219)

classification.plainSummary:
A resolution recognizing the upcoming 250th anniversary of the United States of America and reaffirming the commitment of the Senate to the Nation's founding ideals of liberty, equality, and opportunity for all immigrant communities in the United States.

This is a commemorative or honorific measure ("recognizing the upcoming 250th anniversary"). It carries no sector tags and no donor overlap is computed for it, because attributing an economic interest to a commemorative or procedural measure would be misleading.

plain.whatItDoes: This is a tribute or a commemoration. It does not change any law.
plain.whoItTouches: Nobody directly — this is a statement, not a rule.
plain.everydayEffect: Nothing changes for you. No rule and no payment changes.
plain.source: From the bill title, and from the subject labels that library staff put on it.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
